summary: Deprecate CURRENT.md and complete release-note-first process migration.

entries.migration_impact: Human and agent instructions now point to per-feature change files in `.agentic/releases/` instead of requiring CURRENT.md updates.
entries.agent_notes: When migrating downstream repos, replace CURRENT.md workflow language in docs and wiki pages with release-note change-file guidance.

entries.migration_impact: Feature PR documentation checks now require changed files under `.agentic/releases/`.
entries.agent_notes: Feature PRs in downstream repos should modify release-note change files or they will fail documentation gates.

entries.migration_impact: Template payload no longer ships `CURRENT.md`; templates now guide repos through release-note change-file workflows.
entries.agent_notes: When refreshing from template payload, remove CURRENT.md assumptions and keep `.agentic/releases/` as the canonical state artifact.

entries.migration_impact: Root `CURRENT.md` is now a deprecation stub that redirects to `.agentic/releases/`.
entries.agent_notes: Treat CURRENT.md as compatibility-only and store all new implemented-state evidence in release-note files.
